scope.summary: Roomline source assessment and marketing/account/shared-component/mobile-shell revamp. All 94 filesystem screen templates inventoried; recorded public and component state groups are rendered, remaining application/native work explicitly unverified.

toolReviews.reason: Read the pinned direction workflow and applied hierarchy, spacing and product-specific identity decisions. No remote scripts executed; incompatible export/choreography requirements rejected explicitly.
Read the local wrapper and fresh primary guidelines; applied labels, focus, semantics, keyboard behavior, mobile sizing and reduced-motion checks.
No faithful screenshot-to-code target was requested or chosen for this original product design. Read the moved workflow; comparison captures were used, but no converter was run.
Read the canonical cloud skill, index and selected Linear study. Applied density and documentation principles while retaining the Roomline identity.
Read CLI guidance; actual browser captures and interactions use the installed Playwright library with system Chromium. No CLI execution claim.
Used the connected Attio style reference to inform grouped navigation, restrained surfaces and information hierarchy; no copied identity or live competitor-app audit claim.
Inspected canonical Dropbox iOS sharing/access references and applied separation of sharing, access and actions. Citations and usage notice are preserved in the competitor report.
Read app rules, used and corrected a draft feature map, and consolidated a source-backed assessment and comprehension heuristic. No global team rule was published.
Reviewed the connected 27-node user-flow draft and documented its sequencing correction. Artifact is a design input, not a runtime authorization specification.
Read the applicable skill and actual local Radix APIs; improved customized primitives and a working component reference without bulk registry overwrite.

MCP config is environment-only (${API_KEY_21ST}); CLI installed by tooling agent. Authenticated search remains unavailable until a fresh rotated key is configured. Use scripts/design/21st-mcp.mjs to initialize/list/schema-check before component search; review source/dependencies before adoption. Never run returned code automatically.
No callable UXCritique tool identified. Use a documented project-specific UX review and record unavailable; do not relabel it as execution of this tool.
No callable tool identified. Record an explicit unavailable decision until an authoritative source or integration is connected.
Implemented semantic tokens, shared primitives and a light/dark component reference with real browser evidence and persistent DESIGN.md.
No local file was supplied. Exact-name connected Drive lookup required reauthentication; no personal context inferred and no invented CV contents used.
Read the portable design-system and redesign guidance; applied scoped tokens and preserved product contracts. No remote engine execution claim.
React 19/StyleX package transplantation is outside this React 18 revamp. Source and semantic-state principles were reviewed; package not installed.
Native Rust/GPU implementation is outside this Next.js web repository. Source reviewed; no native source exists here to migrate.
Read craft guidance and applied restrained hierarchy and intentional product content. Reference attribution is preserved; package not installed.
Read the design-inspiration stack guide and applied reference selection by section and task, with source review separated from runtime proof.
Reviewed redirected shadcn fork; its React 19/Next 16/Tailwind 4 examples were not copied into the customized React 18 components.
Separate conversion service reviewed. No conversion target, provider calls or server execution was needed for the original Roomline implementation.
Template reviewed for inspection discipline. No website cloning or incompatible Next 16/React 19 migration was performed.
Read UI/mobile/accessibility/copy guidance; applied clear copy, visible controls, useful recovery and actual state verification. No external installer executed.
Static extraction CLI source reviewed. No external-site extraction or inferred requirements were needed; CLI not executed.
Read landing and token foundations, applying spacing/hierarchy while rejecting generic gradients, font bans and long UI motion.
Read web Apple-design guidance and applied immediate feedback, restrained motion, familiar controls and mobile-web clarity. No native implementation claim.
Read token, state and evidence guidance; applied local shared-component patterns. Incompatible framework adapters and toolkit quality scores were not adopted.
Read task-mode and hardening guidance; applied persuasion to marketing and operational clarity to components/mobile. No engine or detector execution claim.
Read design-system and styling sources; applied accessibility and interaction criteria before decorative choices. No database-search score claimed.
Read the site overview alongside the pinned repository workflow; applied its visual-direction principles without treating marketing claims as measured outcomes.

Cloud skill was read in the initial task. No CLI/design run is established by this review. Use its applicable design workflow when available; document unavailable status rather than silently claiming generation.
Read router/audit instructions and applied source inventory, current competitor evidence, prioritized findings and explicit verification limits.
Read the installed frontend skill and implemented the chosen forest/paper direction, reconciling its generic suggestions with product constraints.
